aggressive_definition: Incident advanced prostate cancer defined as International Union Against Cancer stage III/IV; stage IV was also analyzed separately.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: Complete toenail selenium data were available for 898 advanced (International Union Against Cancer stage III/IV) PCa case subjects and 1176 subcohort members.
study_design: Prospective case-cohort study within the Netherlands Cohort Study.
reason: The prospective analysis examined incident advanced prostate cancer, explicitly defined as stage III/IV. The abstract does not report an analysis of total or general incident prostate cancer. The 58,279 men represent the source cohort, while the exact analytic participant total for the case-cohort analysis cannot be determined without inferring overlap between cases and subcohort members.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Toenail selenium was associated with a reduced risk of advanced PCa; adjusted hazard ratio for the highest vs lowest quintile was 0.37 (95% CI = 0.27 to 0.51; P trend < .001).
estimate_classifications.reason: The estimate directly concerns incident advanced prostate cancer and matches the reported highest-versus-lowest quintile comparison, HR, and confidence interval.

validation_findings: Nested case-control/case-cohort analytic denominator must not be forced to full-cohort N
